meta.title: A Tsunami of Disciples, Leaders, and Christ Communities
meta.description: A simple explanation of how the Lord is raising a Spirit-led tsunami of disciples, leaders, and Christ communities, and how you might walk with Him in it.
brand.name: A Tsunami of Disciples
brand.tagline: From His presence to the nations
hero.tag.primary: A quiet, global move of God
hero.tag.secondary: Loving Him → Obeying Him → Generations of disciples
commands.teaser.note: Eight simple commands we seek to obey and help others obey — plain enough that anyone can learn them, keep them in memory, and pass them on.
wisdom.teaser.note: Before you reach out: we keep no lists of people, share only what is wise, and know and honor the laws where you are. Please read this first.

fits.heading: How This All Fits Together
fits.intro: You may come across more than one address for this work. They are not competing sites; each simply carries a different part.
fits.org: this site: the heart and the “why.” Why loving Him comes first, and what the Lord seems to be doing.
fits.com: the materials to use and share: the actual teaching, in a form you can take, translate, and pass on.
fits.7gc: short links to resources: the updated version, the translation template, and more.
